name: Exploding Kittens: Zombie Kittens
players: 2-5 standalone; 2-9 in the linked combined-game variant
inventory_definition: Box contents, before removing unused cards or dealing. Cat identities are distinct types; artwork variants do not add types or copies.

cards.name: Attack 2x
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: End your turn without drawing and give the next player two turns. If played while under an Attack, transfer all current/remaining untaken turns and add two. Each required turn is played or passed, then ended by drawing or a valid turn-ending card.

cards.name: Attack of the Dead
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: With at least one dead player, end your turn without drawing and give the next living player three turns per dead player. Attack chaining transfers remaining turns and adds the new card's attack amount. Cannot be played when nobody is dead.

cards.name: Cat-O-Lantern
cards.count_source: explodi.ng structured card inventory; named cat split
cards.rule: A single cat has no effect. Discard two with the same cat name to steal one random card. The optional pair/triple combos extend matching to any shared title; a triple requests a named card and fails if the target lacks it. Feral Cat can replace a powerless cat. Cat identities are not interchangeable without a wildcard.

cards.name: Clairvoyance
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: Play when another player rescues themselves from an Exploding Kitten to watch where the Kitten(s) are reinserted. NOW timing permits use by living or dead players outside their turn. You may move over to watch the insertion.

cards.name: Clone
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: On your turn, place it over the top discard; it takes that card's effect. Cannot copy another Clone. Cannot be used outside your turn or while dead, even to copy a NOW card. A cat-plus-Clone pair works only when you play both the cat and Clone yourself.

cards.name: Dig Deeper
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: Inspect the top draw-pile card. Either keep it, or draw and keep the next card no matter what it is, then return the rejected first card to the top. End one turn.

cards.name: Exploding Kitten
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: Reveal it. You may play a Zombie Kitten or choose to die. If dead, place this Kitten face up in front of you and retain your hidden hand for possible revival.

cards.name: Favor
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: Choose another player; they choose one card from their hand to give you. In Zombie Kittens, the target must be living. A held Exploding Kitten can be given away under Streaking rules, which makes the recipient resolve its explosion.

cards.name: Feed The Dead
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: Choose a dead player. Every living player with cards except you gives that player one chosen card. Requires a dead player. NOW timing permits living/dead players to play it outside their turn, before an action starts.

cards.name: Grave Robber
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: Every dead player with cards contributes one chosen card from their hand to the draw pile; shuffle it. Cannot be played if nobody is dead. This is not a NOW card.

cards.name: Nope
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: Cancel an action or combo before it begins; another Nope reverses it. Living or dead players can play it outside their turn. Cannot stop an Exploding Kitten or Zombie Kitten.

cards.name: See the Future 3x
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: Privately inspect the top three cards of the draw pile and return them in the same order. Do not reveal them to others. Continue your turn; this does not replace your final draw.

cards.name: Shuffle NOW
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: Shuffle the draw pile. NOW timing permits use before an action starts even outside your turn, including by dead players in Zombie Kittens. Does not change whose turn it is.

cards.name: Skip
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: End one turn without drawing. An Attack with two required turns needs two Skips to avoid both draws.

cards.name: Super Skip
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: End all your required turns without drawing, including outstanding turns from an Attack.

cards.name: Zombie Kitten
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: After drawing an Exploding Kitten, you may discard Zombie Kitten to survive, but using it is optional. If any player is dead, revive exactly one of your choice. Secretly reinsert your lethal Kitten and that player's lethal Kitten in independently chosen positions without inspecting/reordering other cards. If nobody is dead, only reinsert your own Kitten. Ends one turn. Cannot be Noped.

limitations: The supplied PDF does not fully specify the combined 2-9-player Zombie Apocalypse setup; its official tutorial reference is retained instead of inventing a merged-deck recipe.
